usedFor: Webflow collects form submissions, and EventBrite receives an event through “Create Event”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Form Submission” in Webflow, then “Create Event” in EventBrite
bestTemplate.why: A submitted event form becomes an EventBrite event without retyping the details.

watchOut: “Publish an Event” works on an existing event, so “Create Event” alone does not publish anything.
